_help: Edit this per game. 'nations' = countries to track (order matters only for the cost library). 'factions' must use the keys Axis and Allies. 'minor_countries' feed the 'Minor ...' graphs. 'sub_factions' feed the 'Sub-Faction Analysis' graphs (marker: o s ^ D v p *). Colours are any matplotlib colour.
_punchcard_help: Checkpoint columns of the punch-card tables: "auto" (11 evenly spaced saves) or a list of "YYYY.MM" months and/or "latest". Months without a save are skipped. Bloc names come from sub_factions[].punchcard_name; full country names from 'names' (common tags are built in).
_manpower_help: 'original' = same numbers as the original scripts (if a country has divisions training, their manpower is subtracted from the fielded total; otherwise trained-but-undeployed divisions are added). 'fielded' = only divisions actually on the map.
